xmldoc.short_description: Pairwise distances between two sets of observations.

param_input_item.param_description: real full numeric matrix. Rows are observations.
real full numeric matrix with the same number of columns as X.

distance name or function handle. Supported names include euclidean, squaredeuclidean, sqeuclidean, cityblock, chebychev, chebyshev, cosine, correlation, hamming, jaccard, minkowski, seuclidean, mahalanobis, spearman, fasteuclidean, and fastseuclidean.
optional parameter for minkowski, seuclidean, or mahalanobis.
positive integer number of smallest or largest distances to return for each row of Y.

param_output_item.param_description: distance matrix. Without Smallest or Largest, D has size size(X, 1)-by-size(Y, 1). With Smallest or Largest, D has size min(K, size(X, 1))-by-size(Y, 1).
indices of rows in X for the selected distances. I is available only with Smallest or Largest.

description.p: pdist2 computes pairwise distances between rows of X and rows of Y. Built-in distances return NaN when either row contains NaN. A function handle distance must accept one row of X and all rows of Y, and return one distance per row of Y.

example_item.example_item_description: Find selected distances and row indices.
